title: DAM Population Seed - studio asset archive
subtitle: Realistic multi-format seed data for testing any digital asset manager
description:
A studio-shaped digital asset archive for **populating and testing a DAM** — images, audio, 3D models, video, documents and fonts, with the surrounding structure that makes a DAM exercise realistic: owners, teams, collections, workflow states, review history, custom field values and tags.

Most sample datasets are a flat pile of files. This one is shaped like a working studio archive, so it exercises browse, search, faceting, permissions, previews and review flows rather than just file ingest. It is DAM-agnostic — nothing in the data is specific to any one product.

**Contents:** 1,960 assets across 7 media types. `MANIFEST.json` carries per-asset metadata; `posts.json`, `groups.csv` and `metadata.csv` carry the relational structure.

**MATURE-CONTENT LABEL.** Every asset carries a boolean `mature` in `MANIFEST.json`, a content RATING that is independent of the `sensitivity_tier` clearance. Twelve assets are labelled `true`: public-domain classical nudes and academic life studies from the Met Museum's open-access collection (Titian, Rubens, Cranach, Boucher, Gérôme, Courbet and others), which is the case a museum or studio DAM actually flags. They exist so a DAM's mature switch, per-viewer opt-in and blurred previews can be exercised against real content instead of a synthetic flag. If you do not want them, drop the twelve entries whose `mature` is true and the two posts that carry them — nothing else references them. See ATTRIBUTIONS.md for the list and the reasoning.

**LICENSING IS MIXED — read before redistributing.**
  * Most content is CC0 / CC-BY / public domain (Kenney, Blender Foundation, Wikimedia, NASA, Project Gutenberg, Google Fonts).
  * Some video is under the **Pexels License** (`videos/` named `pexels-*`). Free to use and modify; may not be redistributed on stock-photo or wallpaper platforms.
  * One 3D model (2CylinderEngine) is under the **SCEA Shared Source License**, © Sony Computer Entertainment Inc.

There is therefore **no single aggregate licence**. Every asset carries its own `license` and `attribution` in `MANIFEST.json`, and `ATTRIBUTIONS.md` lists every source. Honour the per-asset terms.

Originally built to seed [Artist Alley](https://artist-alley.org), an open-source self-hosted DAM, and used as its demo dataset — but it is useful for any DAM, catalogue or media-pipeline project.
